title: Higher order Weyl coefficients for the operator curl
summary: We establish refined spectral asymptotics for the operator curl acting on a connected oriented closed Riemannian 3-manifold. We treat positive and negative eigenvalues separately and obtain explicit formulae for the first six global Weyl coefficients. With local Weyl coefficients we compute the first four coefficients as well as the sixth one, and we determine the fifth up to a universal constant.
